'''Ereesa''' was an [[Evocii]] who was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vobbara Yusinduu]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> Ereesa was freed by the [[Alliance Commander]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] during the [[rebellion in the Minboosa District]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Ereesa asked the Commander to recover the Evocii totems for her people in the [[Polluted Swamp|swamp]] of the Minboosa District in exchange for information about the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Hidden Chain dropship|shuttle]] in the district.<ref name="SinkingHistory">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sinking History|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ereesa first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
